## Activity

During October 2018, River Outreach recorded 79 captures. This level of activity provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading performance during the reporting period. Capture activity should continue to be monitored through routine site operations, with any notable changes documented for follow-up.

## Image quality

Of the images captured, 11 were ungradable, representing an ungradable rate of 13.9 per cent. This result should be reviewed alongside local operating conditions and equipment performance. Recurring camera issues should be logged with the service desk so that they can be tracked and addressed through the appropriate support process.

## Grading

Grading identified 7 referable results. The median lag between image capture and grading was 1 day. Timely grading supports the prompt review of referable findings and should remain a focus of ongoing service monitoring. The activity, image quality and grading measures should be considered together when assessing operations at River Outreach for October 2018.
